epic.title: Demo: blocker flow with trivial tasks
epic.description: Three-step linear chain that each only touches one tiny text file

reasoning: Minimal demo so each task is a 1-line file operation Claude Code can finish in seconds

stories.title: Write a two-line poem via three steps

tasks.title: Create step1.txt with one line
tasks.description: Create a new file named step1.txt in the repo root. The file should contain exactly one line: 'roses are red'. Stage and commit the file with message 'step 1'.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: File step1.txt exists and contains 'roses are red'

tasks.title: Append second line to step2.txt
tasks.description: Create a new file named step2.txt in the repo root. Copy the contents of step1.txt into it, then append one more line: 'violets are blue'. Stage and commit with message 'step 2'.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: File step2.txt exists with both lines

tasks.title: Print the final poem to README
tasks.description: Append the contents of step2.txt to the bottom of README.md under a new heading '## Poem'. Stage and commit with message 'step 3'.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: README.md has a '## Poem' section with the two lines
